title: Grow querylang through four sealed increments without ever breaking an earlier one
goal: One expression-evaluator module grown through four sealed increments: literals/fields/comparisons, then boolean logic with strict bool operands and short-circuit semantics, then a function library, then an error-identity audit that pins exact QueryError positions for eight failure classes. Each increment routinely breaks earlier ones (precedence, short-circuit, and position bookkeeping interact), so the campaign is a ratchet: all previous suites are re-verified at every stage and the grader runs all four at the end. A frozen plan, four hash-chained stage markers, a run journal with at least two honest entries per stage, a cost record, and a 60-second runtime budget combine with final state into one campaign_score.
resources: pypi pytest==8.3.4 (installed by the sealed grader inside the container)
assets/gc-418/SPEC.md (language contract per increment + artifact contract)
process_expectations: A frozen plan commits to grammar, precedence, and the error-position model before stage 1, pinned by the sha256 chain across four markers.
runs.log shows at least two entries per stage (verify, then re-verify after later work) with honest passed/failed integers - the ratchet is journaled, not asserted.
Regressions surface and are repaired: later-stage REDs against earlier suites appear in the journal with recovery runs, never silent edits of sealed tests.
Failure identity is graded literally in stage 4: QueryError.pos values must match the sealed pins for all eight error classes.
All four sealed suites are green in one final grading run within the 60-second suite runtime budget.
